GOVERNMENT GAZETTE
ACTS SUPPLEMENT
Published by Authority
The following Act was passed by Parliament and assented to by the President on 25 November 2025:—
Online Safety
(Relief and Accountability) Act 2025

(No. 23 of 2025)

I assent.

THARMAN SHANMUGARATNAM,
President.
25 November 2025.
Date of Commencement: 29 June 2026 Parts 1 and 2 and the sections as notified
An Act to provide persons affected by online harmful activity with timely redress through the office of the Commissioner of Online Safety and rights of action in court proceedings, to improve and promote online safety, and to make related amendments to other Acts.
Be it enacted by the President with the advice and consent of the Parliament of Singapore, as follows:
PART 1
PRELIMINARY
Short title and commencement
1.  This Act is the Online Safety (Relief and Accountability) Act 2025 and comes into operation on a date that the Minister appoints by notification in the Gazette.
